sara_ml: heads up — bringing up q6b-int4 on Dedicated tomorrow, need promptset cleanup before quant-smoke.
miguel: what's the biggest failure mode we're seeing in the warmup runs?
sara_ml: paraphrase + longform duplication causing noisy evals and inflated latents. also some tokenization mismatch on lists.
toni: suggestion: two-stage pipeline — fuzzy dedupe -> label borderline pairs -> golden refresh.
sara_ml: agreed. rough plan:
  1) run fuzzy dedupe (threshold 0.82)
  2) push borderline pairs (0.7-0.82) to labelers
  3) refresh golden set (1k) keeping ~30% longform
  4) run quant-smoke + regression evals
miguel: can you paste the dedupe command you plan to run?
sara_ml: sure:
```bash
python tools/dedupe.py \
  --input s3://redwood/promptbank/q6b-candidate.jsonl \
  --threshold 0.82 \
  --keep-long 0.3 \
  --out s3://redwood/promptbank/q6b-curated.jsonl
```
priya: I'll own labeler coordination. ETA 48h for first pass, unless we need more reviewers.
toni: make sure golden covers codegen, multi-turn, and list-style prompts — those hit the biggest regressions.
ben_ops: I'll provision a dedicated labeling queue: `q6b-int4-label`. Bumping concurrency to 200/min for first 24h window.
sara_ml: @priya please prioritize borderline items where q6b-int4 baseline entropy > 1.5. those seem to correlate with model flip.
priya: got it. I'll filter by entropy and send batches to high-seniority labelers. :thumbsup:
labeler-bot: Assigned 12 annotators to `q6b-int4-label`. Expected throughput: ~1,800/hr. Queue URL: https://labeler.redwood.ai/queues/q6b-int4-label
miguel: after labeling, can we run these eval configs: `promptset_regression.yaml` and `longform_hallucination_4k.yaml`?
sara_ml: yes — I'll kick off the eval job once curated set is in s3 and label QA passes.
toni: also add an adversarial slice of 200 prompts from the edgecase bank — we should surface worst-case hallucinations early.
sara_ml: logging steps in runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/q6b-quant-onboard — will update with timestamps.
miguel: thanks, will watch for outputs. :eyes:
priya: starting labeler prep now. I'll post a short batch report when 500 labeled.
sara_ml: perfect — thanks everyone. will close the loop once regression passes and we decide whether to keep int4 or fallback to int8 for certain shards.
